meta.note: Source of truth for the download area. Going live is a data change, not an HTML edit: flip an entry's status to "available" and fill in version, url, sha256 and size. js/site.js renders this into every [data-downloads] block; the static HTML in index.html and /join must be kept in step (see README.md).
meta.windowsNotice: Testnet build, not code-signed: Windows SmartScreen will warn — choose More info → Run anyway.
meta.mobileNotice: Mobile apps are wallets only. Phones do not mine.

products.name: SWARM Wallet
products.detail: Holds your coins and sends payments — transparent or shielded, your choice on every payment. On first run it shows a recovery phrase; write it down on paper and keep it offline.
products.platformLine: Windows first, Linux and macOS to follow.

products.name: SWARM Node
products.detail: Runs a full node — it downloads the chain, checks every block against the rules itself and relays to its peers — and has a single mining switch. Consent-first: nothing runs hidden, nothing starts by itself.
products.platformLine: Windows first, Linux and macOS to follow.

products.name: SWARM Wallet for Android
products.detail: The same wallet on your phone: hold, send and receive. A wallet only — phones do not mine.
